events.verdict: Clarkson (CLE) sets the pick in Ross' (ORL) path and makes marginal contact with his body as he releases.
Thompson (CLE) is firming up in a legal picking position in Ross' (ORL) path and absorbs contact.
Ross (ORL) intentionally kicks the ball.
Hill (CLE) makes marginal contact with Fournier (ORL) during his drive.
Smith (CLE) establishes a legal picking position in Fournier's (ORL) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Vucevic (ORL) is in the paint without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds as he straddles the lane line and then moves into the middle of the lane.
Vucevic (ORL) maintains an arm to the front of Hill (CLE) and makes marginal contact with his body at the end of the drive.
Fournier (ORL) makes marginal contact with Thompson's (CLE) arm that does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
RLB shows Vucevic (ORL) does not make contact with the ball while it is in the cylinder.
Augustin (ORL) briefly grasps Clarkson (CLE) before correcting.
Clarkson (CLE) extends his arms as he disengages from the pick, but the contact is marginal.
Thompson (CLE) fails to clear the lane and is in the paint for more than three seconds.
Gordon (ORL) makes marginal contact with Thompson (CLE) in the post that does not affect his ability to maintain his position.
Ross (ORL) legally contests Smith's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Vucevic (ORL) sets the screen in Clarkson's (CLE) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Osman (CLE) defends Fournier (ORL) with two hands as he goes over the legal screen and affects his SQBR.
Osman (CLE) and Fournier (ORL) make incidental contact with one another during the loose ball situation.
Fournier (ORL) recovers the ball in the backcourt after Osman (CLE) makes contact with the ball.
Vucevic (ORL) is firming up in a legal picking position in Osman's (CLE) path and absorbs contact.
Clarkson (CLE) dislodges Augustin (ORL) from his legally obtained position.
Fournier (ORL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Korver (CLE).

LLB shows that while Osman (CLE) jumps vertically and absorbs the body contact with Fournier (ORL), he is no longer in a legal guarding position when lowers his arms forward and initiates contact to Fournier's arm. The contact to the arm affects Fournier's driving shot attempt.
Fournier (ORL) clamps Hill's (CLE) arm and affects his ability to get to the pass.
Thompson (CLE) is never established in a screening position and he grabs Fournier (ORL) around the waist without giving him room to avoid the contact.
Vucevic (ORL) collapses his arm to his body as he absorbs contact from Hill (CLE) and cleanly blocks the driving shot attempt.
Gordon (ORL) reaches in and makes contact with Hill's (CLE) wrist, causing him to lose control of the ball.
Thompson (CLE) defends Vucevic (ORL) with two hands but does not affect his ability to set the screen.
Osman (CLE) legally contests Fournier's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
